problems.description: Attackers send deceptive emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into submitting their login credentials on fake websites.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) to reduce impact of stolen credentials
Use email filtering solutions to detect and block phishing emails
Conduct regular user training on recognizing phishing attempts

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing emails crafted using personal or organizational information to deceive specific individuals into divulging sensitive data or executing malicious actions.
risk_reduction: Perform regular security awareness training focused on spear phishing tactics
Verify unexpected requests for sensitive information through secondary channels
Deploy advanced email threat protection with anomaly detection

problems.description: Attackers compromise or spoof executive or finance department email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive data from employees.
risk_reduction: Establish strict verification procedures for financial transactions
Use email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Monitor email accounts for unusual activity and implement anomaly detection
